What is Vertical?

Vertical is a purpose-built ecosystem enabling everyone to participate in customizing AI models. We are building a suite of tools that empowers people of all skill levels to start customizing without the need for extensive resources or coding expertise. We believe training your own models should be accessible and easy, not only for those who know how to code.
